# Task: Calculate saving note redemption rate relative difference (1980 vs 1981)

- [x] Find saving note data for calendar year 1980
- [x] Find saving note data for calendar year 1981
- [x] Calculate average amount outstanding for calendar year 1980 (computed from monthly data: 318.5 million)
- [x] Calculate average amount outstanding for calendar year 1981 (computed from monthly data: 279.83 million)
- [x] Calculate redemption rate as percentage of average amount outstanding for each year
  - 1980: 71/318.5 * 100 = 22.29%
  - 1981: 50/279.83 * 100 = 17.87%
- [x] Calculate relative difference in percentage points (1981 - 1980)
  - 17.87 - 22.29 = -4.42 percentage points (or 4.42 in absolute terms)
- [x] Round to nearest hundredth (2 decimal places): 4.42
- [x] Write answer to /app/answer.txt

## Final Answer: 4.42
